plan.title: feat(dial): escalation evaluation has no evidence source in consumer runs - inputs permanently null, every evaluation declines identically (#3319 follow-up)

narratives.Description: Dial escalation evaluation always declines with insufficient evidence because taskSize and modelTier stay null. Hard multi-clause tasks are evaluated identically to trivial ones.
narratives.Overview:
**TL;DR: dial escalation evaluation (#3319) now emits — and in consumer field runs it always declines with the same vacuous reason: "insufficient evidence to raise above rapid (size=- modelTier=-)". Both inputs are permanently null in this environment, so the evaluation is a coin with one side. The mechanism #3274 built has evidence events now but still no evidence source.**

**Evidence (internal benchmark artifacts, private; framework 0.102.0):** every `dial_escalation_evaluation` event across collected trials: `{"outcome":"declined","reason":"insufficient evidence to raise above rapid (size=- modelTier=-)","tier":"rapid"}`. `taskSize` and `modelTier` are null in `ceremony_dial.inputs` on every session_start. Hard multi-clause tasks that subsequently failed their verifiers were evaluated identically to trivial ones.

## Fix (design first, small)
Wire at least one real input the consumer environment can actually supply, e.g.: task-statement length/structure at intake (clause count from #3323 once stamped — a natural size proxy), failing-gate count mid-session, or a host-supplied tier hint env. Then the evaluation can sometimes escalate, and the #3319 events start carrying information instead of a constant.

Non-goal: changing the rapid default or the decline threshold before an input exists — a threshold on null is still null.

Relates #3319 (events shipped — this is the evidence source), #3274, #3214, #3323 (clause count as size proxy).
narratives.UserStory: As a session owner, I want at least one real ceremony-dial input from the consumer environment, so that escalation evaluation can sometimes raise above rapid instead of always declining.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In packages/core/src/session ceremony-dial evaluation, wire one real input (clause count, failing-gate count, or host tier env) so taskSize/modelTier is not permanently null. Evidence: targeted vitest on packages/core/src/session plus CHANGELOG #3358.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a consumer run, when dial escalation evaluates, at least one of taskSize, modelTier, or an equivalent documented input is non-null when the environment can supply it.
Given that input, when evidence supports raising above rapid, the evaluation is not forced to the vacuous insufficient-evidence decline. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] cites #3358.
